name: Franklin Floats
description: Float service with a primitive campground on the East Fork of the Black River at Lesterville. No website; contact by phone or email. Rental fleet size not published.

name: Parks Bluff Campground
description: 118-site campground on the Black River at Lesterville: tent (no electric), tent electric, 30-amp RV, 30-amp RV with water, and full-hookup 30/50-amp sites with water, electric and sewer. Reservations by phone or contact form.

name: Bearcat Getaway
description: Cabins and 30-amp electric campsites with community water on the Black River near Lesterville; no dump station. Three cabin units — Bearcat Mountain Cabin and Bear Cub Cabin sleep 6 each, Lodge Cabin sleeps 8 — for about 20 guests total. Campsite count not published.

name: Black River Camping at Horse Shoe Ranch
description: Campground on the Black River at Lesterville in three tiers: 30/50-amp with water, tent electric with water, and primitive tent. No sewer hookups; site counts not published. Books through Airbnb and by phone.

name: Riversedge Campground
description: Campground on the Black River at Lesterville with 30-amp electric-and-water sites and primitive camping, plus river float service. Site counts are in flux while the property rebuilds after major flooding.
seasonal_notes: Rebuilding after major flood damage — services limited and site counts in flux as of 2026. Call ahead.

name: Black River Lodge
description: All-inclusive lodge on the Black River at Lesterville, operating since 1946. Cabins named for birds in sizes from 2 to 16 rooms; rates include three meals a day, and the property takes reunion-sized groups of 80+. Tubes rented on site, canoe rental nearby. Reservations by phone.

name: Log Cabin Suites
description: Cabin suites on Highway 21 at Lesterville with access to Black River floating, fishing and hiking. Units include jacuzzi and hot-tub rooms with queen and bunk beds; unit count not published. Books through the property site and Airbnb.

name: Wilderness Lodge Resort
description: All-inclusive resort with 26 cabins, suites and cottages on a mile of Black River frontage at Lesterville; rates include a three-course dinner, lunch and breakfast. Books through Cloudbeds and major travel sites.

name: Sunset Ridge Cabin
description: Single cedar cabin near Lesterville, built in 2010: two full baths, loft and deck, sleeps 8. Twenty minutes from Johnson's Shut-Ins State Park. Books direct by phone.

name: The Black River Cabins
description: Cabins on the Black River at Lesterville; second listed number 573-561-3163. Marked unverified because the theblackrivercabins.com domain no longer resolves — unit count and current operating status could not be confirmed from a primary source.
